name: The Brotherhood
source:
The Brotherhood is a visual novel filled with mystery, adventure, and a story intended to keep you guessing. As you will learn, there is an ancient prophecy that will be fulfilled once the time is right. That time is now! 

Each of the nine main characters play a specific role in the prophecy. Can you guess all nine and their corresponding roles correctly?

[From [url=https://gearwrath.itch.io/the-brotherhood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《兄弟会》是一部充满神秘、冒险和让你不断猜测的视觉小说。正如你将了解到的，一旦时机成熟，一个古老的预言就会实现。那个时间就是现在！

九个主要角色中的每一个都在预言中扮演着特定的角色。你能正确猜出这九个角色以及他们对应的角色吗？

[来自[url=https://gearwrath.itch.io/the-brotherhood]Itch.io[/url]]
